MCQ 
BRAIN TEASER 
9.
A signal flow graph of a system is shown below.
Consider the following statements regarding the 
SFG. 
1.
Two forward paths and five individual
loops.
2.
Three forward path and three pairs of two
non-touching loops.
3.
Total number of individual loops and the
number of pairs of two non – touching
loops are reduced by equal number, if
branch of SFG having gain G6 is removed.
4.
There are three pair of two non - touching
loops.
Which of the following is correct? 
(a) 1, 3 and 4
(b) 2, 3 and 4
(c) 3 and 4 only
(d) 1 and 3 only
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-03 (Signal Flow Graph).
